description: Isolated host running the disposable research runner (Docker). Reaches ASG through a loopback tunnel; ASG reaches the runner through a reverse tunnel. The runner must refuse unsigned requests.

doctor.hint: Build it in the runner folder: docker compose build worker
The runner must listen on 127.0.0.1 only; ASG reaches it through the reverse tunnel.
Open the tunnel to the hub (presets/parent/tunnel shows the pattern; the key must be dedicated and restricted).

verify.description: An unauthenticated POST must be refused (401/403), never served.

steps.step: Run the runner (loopback only) as a scheduled task
Keep the tunnel to the hub up
On the hub: reverse-tunnel port 18790 must listen on loopback (role hub, check runner_reverse_tunnel)
Back up deployed runner files on the isolated host before updating; to roll back, restore the backup, restart, and confirm healthz
Set ASG_ALLOWED_CALLERS to include the actual delegating agent id; a mismatch is rejected at signature verification even for correctly signed requests
Set MODEL_BROKER_HOST/MODEL_BROKER_PORT and MODEL_BROKER_WORKER_MODEL/MODEL_BROKER_INSPECTOR_MODEL on the trusted host only; unset or invalid values must fail closed
